name: BSP_HudMinimapScreen_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet hud_screen_pages, docs/HUD_SCREEN_PAGES.md. Vtable +20h of HUD screen slot 35h. __thiscall(this, float), RET 4 at 005C27DB, body 005C0F20..005C27DB; Ghidra has no function here. Does not read 00E188D8; reads the game 00E188A8 and the manager 00E198C4 eleven times each, refreshes three transforms through BSP_Transform_RefreshWorldMatrix and places icons with three BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalPositionAndBounds calls. Analyzed only. | Packet hud_central_updates, docs/HUD_CENTRAL_UPDATES.md. A Ghidra function now exists here. Body 005C0F20..005C27DB, ret 4; the only one of the three central updates with an SEH frame (handler 00C729CC pushed at 005C0F28). 005BD420 runs unconditionally, then the routine splits on this->[F4h], the selected capture point: non-null shows this->[60h] and advances +16Ch by the delta; null uses this->[60h] virtual +38h and restarts +16Ch once, latched by +169h. Both branches run the same animation: pulse = sinf(00F876A4 * 4.0) (00D7A328), colour (1,1,1, 0.5*pulse+0.5) through virtual +50h on this->[54h], ramp = min(+16Ch*4, 1), scale = ramp*(0.1*pulse+1) through virtual +48h, and the 006F1F90 ring factor on this->[58h] and this->[5Ch]. The unit pass at 005C154E repeats the 0..7 team gate and needs a camera unit from 004B4B00, squares the map half-extents from 00432650 +6Ch/+70h, walks [[[00E188A8+team*4+18CCh]+30h]+E0Ch] filtering on +5Ch set with +5Dh/+60h/+5Eh clear plus virtuals +5Ch(5) and +B8h, culls on 00427E30 of the 00427EB0 offset against the squared extent, and looks up or creates a 0Ch-byte icon entry in the map at this+F8h (005BE110, 005BD590, 005C0700, 00694A60). All three 00AA7DC0 placements use x = dx/1024 (00CEDAE8) and y = -dz/768 (00CE42B0) with depth literals -1, -4, -2, -8 and -10, and rotation pi/2 - heading (00CE3830). Roughly 40% of the body was read instruction by instruction. | Update: Ghidra now has a function here (defined by the integrator from disk-verified bytes, reports/hud_screen_function_definitions.json); docs/HUD_CENTRAL_UPDATES.md reconstructs the body. | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2k (docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md, reports/game_executable_milestone_2k.json): the unit icon pass 005C154E..005C1C99 ran 581 times over the 32 created units of USN02 through bsp::hud_minimap_place_unit_icons_005c154e. The two radii came from Globals["Minimap"] in the installed scripts/datatables/globals.lua as 4000 and 4000; 16 of the 31 units the walk reaches survived the VisibilityRange cull and were placed, and 15 were dropped. 004B4B00 and the renderer basis at 00B6DB70 are executable stand-ins (no camera at game+19FCh) and the four per-unit entry calls 005BE110/005BD590/005C0700/00694A60 are records.

evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this = the mission-tree screen), RET, SEH frame; Ghidra renders it __cdecl(void). Reads the selected record, computes side = (record+0B8h low byte == 0), copies record+00h into game+2198h and game+6B8h, calls 004E2770 with the scene string at record+20h (empty when the data pointer is null), publishes the loading-screen text through 0057D060 from the side block +64h list plus record+08h and the low byte of record+20Ch, and calls 00626930(ECX = record, EDX = side). Then it branches at 005C573A on the selected side block briefing key size: empty writes game+6ACh = (record+0B4h == 3 ? game+6B0h : record+0B4h) and calls 00439020; non-empty calls 0051DCE0(ECX = [00E198AC]+64h, record, side) and 004CC460([00E198AC], 1, 0). Sole caller 005C57D0. See docs/MISSION_TREE_BRIEFING_SCREENS.md. | Packet cc_mission_load, full listing read. side_index = (record+0B8h == 0) at 005c562d..5633; the per-side block is record + 0B8h + side*154h (005c563c IMUL EAX,EAX,0x154). Order: copy the record+0h string to game+2198h, 004e2770(game, record+24h or the empty literal 00e1952f when null, NULL), build a string vector from side_block+64h and the record+8h string and hand it to 0057d060 with the byte at record+20Ch, copy record+0h to game+6B8h, 00626930(record, side). Then the branch at 005c573a on side_block+4h: non-null opens the briefing (0051dce0 on [00e198ac]+64h then 004cc460(1,0)) and stops; null stores the mode from record+0B4h into game+6ACh (value 3 means take game+6B0h instead) and calls 00439020, which queues requests 6 and 0Ah. Always ends with an input update at 0.0f. docs/MISSION_LOAD_PATH.md | Correction (packet cc_mission_briefing): 00626930 takes no side argument. 005C5732 loads EDX with the side index and 00626930 reads ECX only (its first write to EDX is at 0062695D). Also, record+00h is the Lua id and record+08h the Lua name, so what this routine copies into game+2198h and game+6B8h is the id. The briefing arm at 005C573F fills the briefing screen object and then raises interface 1 (INTF_MAINMENU) at 005C5760; the mission-detail page of the main-menu screen is the briefing surface, and the start is queued later by 0058BDF0 through 005922F0.

name: BSP_MissionTreeScreen_LoadTables
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this), RET, SEH frame, 9C0h of stack. Slot +10h of vtable 00CF170C. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register (004F71D0), then reads Scripts/datatables/MissionTree.lua through the keys multiMissionInfos and missionGroups, reporting progress with BSP_LoadingScreen_ReportProgress once per entry of the first loop. The first loop push_backs 34h-byte group entries into the vector at +14h (proxy) / +18h / +1Ch / +20h; the second push_backs 434h-byte mission records into the vector at +24h..+30h. The tail calls 005C3470 with a name from 00586150 and stores the pair into +0Ch (mission index) and +10h (group index), clamping a negative mission index to (0, 0). See docs/MISSION_TREE_BRIEFING_SCREENS.md. | Packet mission_tree_lua_reader: the library mask at 005CAB28 is 4 (the table library alone), not the GUI's 65h. The two loops are settled by their destinations: missionGroups (00CF1750) fills the 34h vector at this+14h through 005CAA40 and 005C9F70, multiMissionInfos (00CF1734) the 434h vector at this+24h through 005C9E30 and 005C6A70, which confirms the inference in docs/MISSION_TREE_BRIEFING_SCREENS.md. Each element is appended empty and filled in place. Progress at 005CAD49 is (float)(one_based_group_index * 0.02 + 0.45), doubles at 00D7A2F8 and 00CF1748, reported once per group only. The only reference to this routine is 00CF171C, slot +10h of vtable 00CF170C. docs/MISSION_TREE_LUA_READER.md. | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2e (packet cc_exe_2e). Run in process as the mission-tree screen's register virtual over stock Lua 5.1.1 with library mask 4 and the mounted VFS. Scripts/datatables/MissionTree.lua, including its DoFile of MultiGlobals.lua, evaluated and the MissionTree global read: 5 groups (Training grounds 22, IJN campaign 30, USN campaign 36, IJN DLC 27, USN DLC 28), 143 missions and 34 multiMissionInfos entries. The group order matches the published group index 0058C010 switches on. The selection tail resolved the id USN02 to group 2 mission 13; an unknown id clamps to (0,0) as the reconstruction states.
